name: Ageing Report for Pending Opportunities
query:
SELECT 
    name AS "Opportunity ID:Link/Opportunity:150",
    customer_name AS "Customer Name::200",
    opportunity_owner AS "Owner:Link/User:120",
    opportunity_type AS "Type::120",
    sales_stage AS "Sales Stage::120",
    creation AS "Created On:Date:120",
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) AS "Age (Days):Int:100",
    expected_closing AS "Expected Closing:Date:120",
    status AS "Status::100"
FROM 
    `tabOpportunity`
WHERE 
    status NOT IN ('Converted', 'Lost')
ORDER BY 
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) DESC;
